creative_direction: Depict Himawari Nohara as an infant with her small forehead curl, round cheeks, and soft baby romper. Support her in front of a plain cushion, framing only the upper body. Her hands rest together near her chest, and she looks forward with mild curiosity. Keep all proportions infant-like, with no makeup or adult accessories. Use varied ink line weight, light pigment washes, and generous negative space. Use muted rose-violet irises with fine concentric rings, visible pupils, and clear highlights. Place a pale moon disc behind the character; keep the mood gentle and unthreatening. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
